title: TransactionAcknowledgement

ConversationID.description: The unique request ID returned my M-PESA for each request made

OriginatorConversationID.description: Unique string generated by the merchant system for every B2C request to avoid double disbursement. You can use this ID to query the status of a transaction before making another disbursement.

ResponseCode.description: The numeric status code indicates the status transaction processing. 0 means success and any other code means an error occurred or the transaction failed.

description: Synchronous acknowledgement returned by the asynchronous M-Pesa command APIs (B2C, B2B, B2Pochi, Reversal, Transaction Status, Account Balance, Tax Remittance). The final outcome is POSTed to ResultURL as a ResultCallback.
